Tooltip_craft_CraneMod_WinchDesc: A welded winch on the edge of an upper floor. The rope drops past the edge to the floor below. Needs Metalworking 3 by default (sandbox option); below that the placement stays red.
Tooltip_craft_CraneMod_BoxDesc: A box that hangs from a crane winch. Build it on the crane's hook on the floor below. Needs Carpentry 3 by default (sandbox option); below that the placement stays red.
